# ADR trigger notes — R4.15e (2026-10-22)

Re-homed fired-trigger records (landed ADR bodies are frozen — BM-ADR-01;
precedent `2026-10-22-adr-0346-trigger.md`). Source: the R4.15e run
ledger (`docs/build/runs/R4.15e.md`) is the narrative home.

## ADR-0345 — revisit trigger (b): FIRED-ANSWERED

Trigger text: *"Reopen if … (b) real signer/witness key custody lands
and the `hmac-sha256` construction is replaced (OQ-170 closure —
cosignature verification is construction-agnostic at the codec level,
but `CHECKPOINT_ALG` spelling would change)…"*

R4.15e lands real signer key custody — the OQ-170 closure the trigger
names — and the disposition the trigger anticipated is exactly what
landed:

- **Real signer custody landed** — the kernel-held Ed25519 signer under
  `hh-secrets` (`LedgerSignerCustody`,
  `<HH_STORE_ROOT>/secrets/ledger-signer.<key_id>.pkcs8` mode `0600`),
  provisioned through `CredentialBroker::kernel_use(KernelPurpose::
  LedgerSigning)`, adopted at GATE-G7 per the BL-30 OQ-170 brief;
  dep-scope recorded by ADR-0376 (the ADR-0359 D2 scope extension).
- **The `hmac-sha256` construction is *extended*, not replaced.** The
  signature codec dispatches on the claim's declared `alg_ref` member:
  `CHECKPOINT_ALG` (`"hmac-sha256"`) keeps its spelling for the C0
  `FixedSigner`/`KeyTable` construction — existing signed runs and
  fixtures do not break — and `ED25519_ALG` (`"ed25519"`) joins it
  additively under one `<alg>:<hex>` codec (`render_sig_alg`/
  `parse_sig_alg`, CHECKPOINT_ALGS = {hmac-sha256, ed25519}; CC8).
  The `CHECKPOINT_ALG` spelling the trigger worried about is
  **unchanged** — no signature, witness-cosignature, or receipt codec
  renames.
- **Cosignature verification is construction-agnostic at the codec
  level, as the trigger predicted.** Witness cosignatures
  (`witness_cosignatures[{witness_name, key_id, timestamp, sig}]`) and
  the receipt lift are checked through `AuditKeyResolver::verify_sig`,
  which dispatches the declared `alg_ref` — ADR-0345 D1's witness seam
  needed no amendment: a witness signer under either admitted
  construction mints and verifies through the same members. Witness
  *custody* stays external identically (the OQ-170 ruling's own
  reservation — witness keys adopt the same per-installation file
  convention when witness declarations land; ADR-0376's revisit trigger
  carries that forward).
- **`signer_key_ids` accumulation is additive.** Manifests carry the
  custody's full key-id set (current + retired); `key_rotation{from,
  to}` claims fold `to_key_id` into the verifier's effective signer set
  while retired ids stay resolvable — ADR-0345's rotation findings are
  untouched.

Trigger (c) — a standalone `AuditPolicy` record migrating
`witness_policy` — stays **conditional/unchanged**: no `AuditPolicy`
record landed; the manifest member is as declared.

BL-30 discharge: the row's "ADR-0345 trigger (b) rides the custody
ruling" member is answered by this sheet — the trigger fired on the
custody landing and is answered by the additive construction (no codec
or spelling change), recorded here per the register's re-homed-notes
convention.
